phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Nine reported Montenegro land cargo posts: Debeli Brijeg–Karasovići (Croatia); Ilino Brdo–Klobuk, Vraćenovići–Deleuša and Metaljka–Metaljka (Bosnia and Herzegovina); Dračenovac–Špiljani, Ranče–Jabuka and Dobrakovo–Gostun (Serbia); Kula–Kulina (Kosovo); Božaj–Hani Hotit (Albania). Port Bar is outside this land-border record.
